cohort: The study included 396 postnatal women within 7 days of delivery at St. Francis Referral Hospital and Kibaoni Health Center in Ifakara Town, Tanzania.
finding: Good ANC consistency (>= 4 visits) was observed in 66.2% of participants, and younger age, health insurance, and positive provider relationships significantly influenced consistent ANC attendance, while a complex relationship with maternal complications was observed.
cross-section timing: Between August and September 2024, enrolling postnatal women within 7 days of delivery.
